content.text:
All three fixes are applied. Here is a summary of every change made:

**Fix 1 — `/src/components/blog/blog-grid.module.css`**
- `.section`: `background-color` changed from `#f5f7fa` to `#ecf7fd`, added `border-bottom-right-radius: 80px`, `border-bottom-left-radius: 80px`, `display: block`, `position: relative`, padding changed from `64px 5% 80px` to `0 3% 80px`.
- Mobile `@media (max-width: 640px)` `.section`: padding-top removed (was `48px`), now `0 5% 64px` to stay consistent with the zero top padding.

**Fix 2 — `/src/components/blog/blog-hero.module.css`**
- `.section`: `background-color` changed from `#092245` to `transparent`, padding rewritten to `padding-top: 4rem` / `padding-bottom: 4rem`, added `font-weight: 400` and `text-decoration: none`.
- `.heading`: `color` changed from `#ffffff` to `#082753`.
- `.subtitle`: `color` changed from `rgba(255,255,255,0.65)` to `#5b616e`.
- `.badge`: `background-color` changed from `rgba(255,255,255,0.08)` to `rgba(33,207,255,0.1)`, `border` changed from `rgba(255,255,255,0.14)` to `#05bafe40`.
- `.badgeLabel`: `color` changed from `#ffffff` to `#082753`.
- `.badgeIcon`: `filter: brightness(0) invert(1)` removed entirely.
- Mobile `@media (max-width: 640px)` `.section`: rewritten to use `padding-top: 2.5rem` / `padding-bottom: 2.5rem` (removed the old fixed-pixel shorthand that had a `64px` top value from the dark-bg era).
- `.cta` left untouched.

**Fix 3 — `/src/components/our-works/portfolio-grid.module.css`**
- `.section`: `background-color` changed from `#f5f7fa` to `transparent`, `padding` changed from `20px 5% 40px` to `20px 5% 60px`, added `display: block`.
- Mobile `@media (max-width: 767px)` `.section`: padding changed from `32px 5% 64px` to `20px 5% 60px` to keep parity with the updated base rule.
